title: Designing Distributed Rate Limiters: Sliding Window with Redis and Cell Rate Limiting (GCRA)
coreConcept: Implementing Generic Cell Rate Algorithm (GCRA) using theoretical arrival time (TAT) to enforce perfectly smooth rate limiting without bursts.
codeSnippet:
-- Redis Lua GCRA rate limiter
local key = KEYS[1]
local now = tonumber(ARGV[1])
local emission_interval = tonumber(ARGV[2])
local delay_tolerance = tonumber(ARGV[3])
local tat = tonumber(redis.call('get', key) or now)
local new_tat = math.max(tat, now) + emission_interval
if new_tat - now <= delay_tolerance then
  redis.call('set', key, new_tat)
  return 1
else return 0 end
